explicit_text.requires: Explicit source product statement; trim whitespace only.

identity_text.requires: Source identity or selected variant; keep case and identifiers; do not unify different sellers.

gtin.requires: Explicit GTIN; retain leading zeroes; review invalid length/check digit.

product_group.requires: Explicit category/form or reviewed decision; no inferred inclusion from a broad store category.

review_only.requires: Named reviewer, reason, and resolvable source evidence; automatic extraction cannot create relationship IDs.

controlled_label.requires: Exact semantic alias from source-mappings.json; unfamiliar labels remain unmapped.

controlled_list.requires: Deduplicate and sort recognized labels; preserve unmatched original claims separately; known empty needs explicit complete negative statement.

percentage.requires: Value from 0 to 100 with component/product scope and exact/minimum/approximate qualifier; conflicting bases are not averaged.

source_section.requires: Product-specific source section excluding navigation/footer/general advice; raw evidence remains verbatim.

ingredient_list.requires: Explicit ingredient section; keep compounds, quantities and raw source pointer; do not infer allergen absence from missing section.

scoped_presence.requires: Positive or explicit negative ingredient/cross-contact statement; ingredients and may-contain stay separate; unmentioned is unknown.

scoped_claim.requires: Affirmed/negated claim applying to this product or declared component; conditional claims keep qualifier and are excluded from unconditional model indicators.

named_scheme_list.requires: Named scheme and scoped source claim; generic fair trade/direct trade never becomes Fairtrade; certification is not independently audited.

nutrition_per_100g.requires: Explicit per-100g basis or reviewed serving-mass conversion; never use nutrition amounts as pack mass; sodium is not salt.

nutrition_basis.requires: Retain declared source basis including prepared/per-serving; no silent basis assignment.

edible_mass.requires: Explicit net/edible mass, exact multipack count and per-unit basis when multiplying; source Shopify grams/weight can be shipping weight and are excluded.

positive_integer.requires: Positive integer explicitly declaring pack/piece count; a total mass alone does not establish count.

country_labels.requires: Controlled observed country aliases; preserve role (cocoa origin/manufacture); unknown country names remain unmapped until registry extension.

explicit_list.requires: Explicit product statements; normalize whitespace, deduplicate and sort without inventing new labels.

temperature_c.requires: Explicit product storage temperature; Fahrenheit conversion must be recorded, never infer a typical range.

duration_days.requires: Days/weeks only automatically (week=7 days); no automatic month/year or vague short-shelf-life conversion.

iso_date.requires: Unambiguous source date to YYYY-MM-DD; ambiguous numeric locale or missing year requires review.

source_role.requires: Versioned source-role registry or evidence-backed reviewed source role; never infer retailer/brand role from product brand equality.

policies.identity: One row per deduplicated seller listing; keep brand shops and retailers in separate partitions. Family/physical-product relationships group validation only and never merge different sellers.
policies.missingness: Unmentioned is unknown, not absent, false, zero, or an empty list. Non-known states have null value; not_applicable requires a recorded reason.
policies.conflict: Incompatible facts for the same attribute, scope and time remain conflict/null with all evidence; preserve historical/variant differences for review rather than selecting a convenient value.
policies.evidence: Every known, conflicting, or reviewed not-applicable assertion references original capture JSON pointers. Extraction confidence/review is distinct from independent factual verification.
policies.scope: Product, ingredient, brand, packaging, packaging_component and observation scopes remain distinct; brand/footer statements cannot become unconditional product facts.
policies.coverage: The catalog covers current observed information families. Unmapped original claims are retained for review and schema extension; optional fields may remain entirely unknown.
policies.prices: Price observations, promotion/reference/regular distinctions, tax/time/source availability and normalized targets remain in separate evidence-backed tables; target values are never attributes/predictors.
policies.evolution: Version catalog, mappings, rule implementation and generated dataset; changing names/meaning/units/labels/rules requires migration notes and documentation update.
